snippet.title: Broke Wizards - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
From the Creators of Scribblenauts, Broke Wizards is a 1-6 player co-op game where you and your roommates do crazy jobs to pay rent to your giant Imp Landlord.

Wishlist now!
